Job Description: Senior Embedded Systems Engineer

Job Title: Senior Embedded Systems Engineer
Department: Engineering and Firmware Development

Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, and test low-level firmware for real-time operating systems (RTOS) using C and C++ programming languages.
- Architect microcontroller-based hardware interfaces, utilizing communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, and CAN bus.
- Collaborate with hardware and electrical engineering teams to review schematics, debug board-bring-up issues, and validate prototype performance.
- Optimize memory usage, power consumption, and processing speed for resource-constrained IoT edge devices.
- Write comprehensive unit tests and automated test scripts to ensure high code reliability and compliance with safety-critical standards.
- Maintain and update technical documentation, architecture specifications, and version control repositories utilizing Git.
- Mentor junior firmware engineers, conduct code reviews, and drive best practices in embedded software development lifecycle (SDLC).

Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline (Master’s preferred).
- Minimum of 6+ years of professional experience in embedded software engineering, firmware development, or hardware-software integration.
- Demonstrated proficiency in C/C++, assembly language, and hardware debugging tools such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
- Deep understanding of microcontroller architectures (ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, etc.) and peripheral driver development.
- Strong problem-solving skills, ability to read complex electrical schematics, and experience with cross-functional technical leadership.
output:
Score: 0
Rationale: The candidate's background is entirely rooted in accounting, business management, and administrative operations with no technical overlap with embedded systems engineering. The resume lacks any required technical skills such as C/C++ programming, firmware development, or engineering degrees, making it a complete mismatch for this role.

Job Description: Wellness Program Coordinator

We are seeking a dedicated and organized Wellness Program Coordinator to design, implement, and oversee health and fitness initiatives for our organization. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in health promotion, physical education, and community wellness.

Responsibilities:
- Plan, coordinate, and execute daily operations of campus or community fitness programs, special events, and health education workshops.
- Recruit, interview, hire, train, and supervise group fitness instructors and support staff, ensuring all certifications (such as CPR and First Aid) remain up to date.
- Manage facility schedules, equipment inventories, and administrative tasks including staff payroll and records management.
- Collaborate with various departments and community partners to promote healthy lifestyle choices through targeted outreach, incentive programs, and wellness campaigns.
- Teach health-related courses, lead fitness classes, and conduct individual fitness assessments and consultations as needed.
- Develop comprehensive marketing materials and informational displays to increase member engagement and program participation.

Requirements:
- Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Health Promotion, Physical Education, Exercise Science, Human Nutrition, or a related field.
- Minimum of 2-4 years of experience in fitness program management, staff supervision, and event coordination.
- Current CPR and First Aid certifications.
- Excellent interpersonal, communication, and public speaking skills, with the ability to engage diverse populations.
- Proven capability in administrative tasks, including scheduling, payroll processing, and maintaining accurate records.
- Strong organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, budgets, and teaching or training loads simultaneously.

Job Description: Senior Pediatric Nurse Practitioner

Responsibilities
Provide direct, comprehensive primary healthcare to pediatric patients from infancy through adolescence in a fast-paced clinical setting. Perform routine well-child examinations, developmental screenings, and acute illness assessments. Diagnose and treat common childhood illnesses and injuries, order and interpret diagnostic laboratory and imaging tests, and prescribe appropriate pharmacological and non-pharmacological treatments in accordance with state and federal regulations. Educate parents and caregivers on preventative healthcare, nutrition, safety, immunizations, and chronic disease management. Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary healthcare teams, including pediatricians, medical assistants, social workers, and administrative staff, to ensure coordinated and compassionate patient-centered care. Maintain accurate and up-to-date electronic health records (EHR) for every patient encounter, adhering to strict HIPAA compliance and medical confidentiality guidelines. Participate in quality improvement initiatives, clinical audits, and staff training programs to uphold high standards of patient safety and clinical excellence.

Requirements
Current and unencumbered Registered Nurse (RN) and Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) licensure in the state. Master’s or Doctorate degree from an accredited Pediatric Nurse Practitioner (PNP) program. Job Description: Assistant Store Manager, Retail Operations

Responsibilities:
- Oversee daily store operations, ensuring a seamless shopping environment that maximizes profitability and minimizes operational costs.
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of 20+ employees, including performance tracking, payroll management, and conducting annual reviews.
- Implement corporate merchandising strategies, visual presentations, and inventory control measures to achieve weekly and monthly sales targets.
- Manage complex customer service inquiries, resolve escalated issues, and maintain high standards of customer satisfaction and brand loyalty.
- Monitor profit and loss (P&L) statements, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and coordinate vendor communications regarding product inventory and shipments.
- Spearhead loss prevention initiatives, store audits, and large-scale merchandising refits or departmental reorganizations.

Requirements:
- Minimum 3-5 years of retail management experience, including supervisory or assistant store manager roles.
- Proven expertise in P&L management, inventory control, and visual merchandising.
- Strong leadership skills with a demonstrated track record of staff training, development, and team motivation.
- Excellent interpersonal and conflict resolution abilities for handling customer escalations and vendor relations.
- Associate degree in Business Management or a related field preferred.

Job Description: Senior Business Banking Relationship Manager

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Banking Relationship Manager to join our commercial banking division. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving revenue growth, managing a portfolio of commercial clients, and delivering tailored financial solutions including credit and cash management services. 

Key Responsibilities:
- Source, develop, and retain profitable business banking and commercial relationships through proactive networking and partner referrals.
- Perform comprehensive credit and financial analyses, evaluating cash flow, balance sheets, and collateral to structure sound credit requests.
- Collaborate closely with underwriting and internal risk management teams to ensure timely and accurate loan approvals.
- Cross-sell a full suite of banking and financial products to maximize portfolio profitability and client retention.
- Monitor existing portfolio credit quality and ensure adherence to regulatory standards and internal policies.

Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA is a strong plus.
- Minimum of 5 years of experience in business banking, commercial lending, or branch management.
- Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding aggressive sales, loan volume, and deposit growth targets.
- Strong knowledge of credit risk fundamentals, financial statements analysis, and banking procedures.
- Excellent communication, relationship management, and negotiation skills.

Job Description: Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to design, develop, and test low-level software for next-generation Internet of Things (IoT) devices. In this role, you will write robust C and C++ code for ARM Cortex microcontrollers, implement communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, and BLE, and collaborate with hardware design teams to debug complex board-level issues.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, implement, and maintain scalable firmware for real-time embedded systems from concept to production.
- Perform rigorous unit testing, code reviews, and hardware-software integration debugging using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and emulators.
- Optimize power consumption, memory footprint, and processing efficiency for resource-constrained battery-powered hardware.
- Write comprehensive technical documentation, including software architecture specifications and API documentation.

Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline (Master's degree preferred).
- Minimum of 6 years of professional experience in embedded software development and bare-metal programming.
- Advanced proficiency in C/C++ programming, real-time operating systems (RTOS), and hardware debugging tools.
- Demonstrated track record of shipping commercial embedded products.
output:
Score: 5
